commitment_binding_policy.reason: A4's published unit commitments are content-blind by design (builder_packet_consumption.unit_commitment_algorithm.content_blind == true): a commitment HMAC carries no stratum label. Binding a specific commitment to a specific stratum's public slot would require opening the private source_unit_id-to-stratum mapping, which this module must never do -- publishing the result would itself be a stratum-to-commitment leak forbidden by the V4 rights/firewall contract. Every assignment_status this module can ever publish is therefore "residual".
